items.title: Recon Kolkata to East Asia (Package 3)
items.placementTarget: Board map at 20° N, 100° E (over Door 53's Kolkata recon placeholder sticker)
items.text:
A B C D E (5 black cards)
Recon with 5 unique black cards from a supply center here to open Package 3.

mechanics.trigger: Opened when monitoring frequency 9.2 on the Frequency Scanner (08-04)
mechanics.effect: Place this map sticker over the Kolkata recon area (20° N, 100° E) if East Asia has not yet been reconned. Enables Recon out of Kolkata (requires a supply center and 5 unique black cards) to open Package 3 (East Asia).
restrictions: Only add to the board if East Asia has not yet been Reconned.

items.title: TRANSMISSIONS DECODED
items.text:
TRANSMISSIONS DECODED
We have decoded the Hollow Men's transmissions. We now know their patrol routes and can sneak by them into Asia.
[Sticker: A B C D E black — Recon with 5 unique black cards from a supply center here to open Package 3.]
Add this sticker to the board if you have not Reconned East Asia.

mechanics.effect: Full sticker carrier card containing item-01 (the Kolkata-to-East-Asia Recon sticker).
restrictions: Only add to the board if East Asia has not yet been Reconned.

summary: TRANSMISSIONS DECODED (opened by Frequency Scanner 9.2): provides the Kolkata Recon map sticker (20° N, 100° E) allowing Recon with 5 unique black cards from a supply center in Kolkata to open Package 3 (East Asia), if East Asia has not yet been reconned.
